Name: DRIJUICE's Camels for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from DRIJUICE, I've updated their Camels (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13189]here[/url]) to work with SVD 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to DRIJUICE.

There's 4 varieties of camels. They live in barns and produce camel hair that can be turned into yarn.

Enjoy!
